title: Pre-registered offline combined counter combined-v1 (PG-Lattice + log-Gabor bank), WVAQ @ WACV 2027
statement_no_labels: When this record and every prediction file listed below were written, no human count of the 76 PickGlass scene representatives (or of any of the 150 files) existed: the external annotator's (A1) exports had not yet been delivered. This work did not look for, open or use any annotation export (annotation_tool/data/saved, annotator exports) or any propagated label. The only labels used were exact synthetic-generator labels (fit) and, AFTER this freeze and reported as post hoc, the 13 legacy hand counts, which had already been used during the development of the counters.
motivation: Known pattern on the legacy-13 degradation study (post hoc): ours (PG-Lattice) is better clean-ish and under x8 down-scaling, strong glare and phone-camera profiles, but over-counts catastrophically under Gaussian defocus 1-4u (MAPE 50-246 %) where the log-Gabor bank degrades gracefully (10-40 %). The rule family therefore contains a defocus fallback to log-Gabor driven by the resolvability ratio rho of the cascade (supplement Sec. S11), plus an agreement term; thresholds were left to the synthetic fit.

rule.definition: Per photo: rho = sharpness / (4 sin^2(pi f))^2, f = max(ours_h, ours_v) / n_work, n_work = min(max(H, W), 1024); if rho < R_MIN -> log-Gabor on both axes; else per axis: if |ln(ours/gabor)| <= D_AGREE -> sqrt(ours * gabor), else ours. A non-finite component is replaced by the other; both non-finite -> NaN. Inputs are the frozen counter's ours and log-Gabor outputs on the same pixels (preproc lcn, glare mask).

thresholds_secondary.status: sensitivity analysis only (MAPE objective); not for Tab. 1

rule.effective_primary_rule_in_words: The P5 objective switched the defocus fallback off (R_MIN = 0): combined-v1 = per axis, the geometric mean of ours and log-Gabor when they agree within a factor e^0.18 = 1.197, otherwise ours.

objective.primary: maximise P5 = share of counts with |pred/true-1| <= 5% (non-finite = miss, APE 100%); ties (equal hits) -> lower MAPE; remaining ties -> smaller R_MIN, then smaller D_AGREE
objective.secondary: minimise MAPE; ties -> more hits within 5%; then smaller R_MIN, smaller D_AGREE

grid.r_min: 0 and the 0.25%..30% quantiles (step 0.25%) of rho over the fit rows (119 values)

objective.source: objective fixed in advance ('maximise share of counts within 5 % (P5), tie-break MAPE')

S-cal-legacygrid.generator: cnn/synth.py v2, r_sensor ~ U[1630, 1940] px/inch, crop not capped

synthetic_data.note: S-cal was produced earlier for the cascade (paper/tools/cascade_tradeoff.py); it had never been used to choose anything about ours vs log-Gabor. Same seeds in both variants (different sensor grids), so the two variants are not independent fabrics.

counter.note: byte-identical, md5 3d0520d6... as recorded in paper/PLAN.md; imported by path, never modified

real150.note: methods/run_ours_150.py (methods/counting.py, whose estimators are identical to the frozen counter; the two files differ only in guide_positions())

legacy13_clean.note: recount = combined_frozen_v1.estimate() on vlm/crops/legacy/*.png; reproduces the stored ours and log-Gabor counts exactly

real150_wide_for_score150.convention: <key>__v = VERTICAL yarns = our h (VLM wide format)

heldout_test.status: declared here, run after this record was written (methods/combined_v1.py --heldout-score, --eval-synth); crops rendered before the freeze but never scored before it

data.H-legacygrid: fresh cnn/synth.py v2 seeds 970000..970199, legacy-like sensor grid (as S-cal)
data.conditions: the same 19 as S-cal (clean; gblur 1,2,3,4,6u; down x2,4,8; jpeg 90,50,20; glare 5,10,20,30 %; corners 2,5,10 %), methods/degrade.py, seed crc32(name) % 100003
data.seed_check: no other study uses 970000+ or 975000+ (training 0..102399, synth_val 900000+, synth_val_v2 910000+, S-cal 930000+, guard 960000+/965000+)

heldout_test.primary_metric: P5 over all held-out counts (both sets, all 19 conditions, 2 counts per row)
heldout_test.inference: paired cluster bootstrap over synthetic crops (both counts and all 19 conditions of a crop resampled together), 10 000 resamples, seed 20261011; 95 % percentile CI of the P5 difference (percentage points) and of the MAPE difference
heldout_test.decision_rule: combined-v1 is 'better than both components' iff its held-out P5 exceeds both ours' and log-Gabor's AND both 95 % CIs of the P5 difference exclude 0. Otherwise the record says so and recommends NOT adding combined-v1 to Tab. 1.
heldout_test.also_reported: MAPE, P10, per condition, per generator variant, clean only; the secondary variant

label_day_plan.scoring: tools/score150.py ... --extra-wide ../methods/results/combined_v1_150_wide.csv::combined-v1 (per scene, n = labelled representatives; same metrics as every Tab. 1 row: MAE, MAPE [CI], w5, w10, both5, bias_med)
label_day_plan.paired: label_day.py paired(): per-scene mean APE, combined-v1 vs Ours and vs Log-Gabor bank (scene bootstrap 10 000, Wilcoxon)
label_day_plan.condition: only if the held-out synthetic test passes; the secondary variant only in the supplement
label_day_plan.no_refit: thresholds are never refitted on human labels

legacy_disclosure: Legacy-13 results (clean, degradations, PickGlass-Stress) are POST HOC: the 13 hand counts were used during development of ours and the defocus pattern motivated this rule family.
